email.title: Change email
email.requestDescription: We'll send a code to {{email}} and another to the new address.
email.newCodeDescription: Last step: enter the code we sent to {{email}} to confirm the new address.

password.title: Change password
password.codeDescription: Enter the code we sent to {{email}} and your new password.

updateModals.identityDescription: To make sure it's you, we'll send a code to {{email}}.
updateModals.identityCodeDescription: Enter the code we sent to {{email}}.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.message:
Your account, recipes and photos will be deleted from the cloud and from this device. This can't be undone.

Deleting the account doesn't cancel a subscription bought in the App Store or Google Play. Cancel it in your store settings.

logout.title: Log out
logout.deviceOnlyMessage:
Your recipes are saved only on this device, not in the cloud. Logging out deletes them from this device, and they can't be restored.

To keep them, turn on cloud sync with Premium before logging out.
logout.unsyncedMessage:
Some of your changes haven't uploaded to the cloud yet. Logging out now deletes them from this device.

To keep them, connect to the internet and wait for them to upload.

cloudSync.requiredForTeamMessage: To create a shared team, turn on cloud sync first so team members can see your recipes.
cloudSync.premiumTitle: Cloud sync is part of Premium
cloudSync.premiumMessage: Upgrade to Premium to back up your recipes to the cloud and share them with your team.
cloudSync.disableMessage: Your recipes stay on this device. Their copy in the cloud will be deleted in 30 days, unless you turn cloud sync back on before then.
cloudSync.disableTeamMessage: Your recipes stay on this device, but new recipes and changes won't reach your team. In 30 days your recipes will be deleted from the cloud and from your team, unless you turn cloud sync back on before then.
